item.title: Jagex Has Banned Over 1 Million Bots On OLD SCHOOL RUNESCAPE In One Month
item.description: Jagex has banned over 1 million bot accounts in Old School RuneScape during January 2026, a massive jump from December's 582k, signaling their aggressive anti-bot efforts amid ongoing player complaints.
